data.name: Hansika
data.gender_notes: Hansika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Named after Goddess Hansa, the embodiment of compassion and peace. She is depicted with swan as her vehicle and is known to protect and nourish her devotees. The name Hansika carries the meaning “Goddess Hansa's delight” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hansika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess hansa's delight and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes divine grace, compassion, and peace
data.etymology: Hansika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess Hansa's delight.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hansika total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

The name evokes notions of elegant grace and inner tranquility. Hansa is renowned for her gentle and compassionate demeanor, and as a result, a child named Hansika is likely to be seen as a symbol of love, kindness, and devotion.

historical_references.reference: Hansika is the name of a famous South Indian actress who has acted in several Tamil, Telugu and Kannada films. She began her acting career in the late 1990s and has been a popular figure in the industry ever since.

Hansika is also the name of a celestial nymph or Apsara in Hindu mythology. She is described as the embodiment of beauty, grace and sensuality. She is said to have been created by the gods to soothe the sage Vedanta Desika during a period of intense meditation.
